اقترضتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضَتَا (iqtaraḍatā) /iq.ta.ra.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضَتَا (uqturiḍatā) /uq.tu.ri.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
